column1: # Q05 backfill: split 4, BOTH modes, lost to the pdex shared-memory race (F-infra1).
# WHY THIS ONE. Q05 (M06 + latent cosine at 1x parity) scores 0.3787 on 4/5 splits -- the
# highest number in the campaign -- but Q02 at 0.3783 on 5/5 is the defensible best precisely
# because Q05 is short a split. This closes that gap so the two are comparable.
# `calibrate=both` because BOTH modes are missing for this split, and re-running a mode that
# already succeeded would risk replacing a good score with a freshly raced one.
